summary: Full-extraction pass over 14 English ACRC annual reports (2010, 2011, 2013-2020, 2022-2025) and 6 Korean ACRC press releases (2016-2021). The reports' whistleblowing chapters were read in full (other chapters scanned and judged out of scope); every table and printed figure on corruption reports, public-interest reports, subsidy/public-funds fraud reports, Graft Act violation reports, referrals and their results, sanctions and amounts to be recovered, counselling, protection requests, rewards, awards and relief funds was extracted, including the repeated history tables each edition reprints (one row per claim). Each report revises earlier years in places (protection tables, subsidy-centre series, public-interest handling); differences are kept and noted. Korean amounts were read with 억 = 100,000,000 and 만 = 10,000 and recorded in units of 만 (scale 'ten thousand') or 억 (scale 'hundred million') as the existing rows do. Breakdown keys used: category= (corruption, code_of_conduct, public_interest, public_subsidy_fraud for the subsidy-fraud centre series from Oct 2013, public_funds_fraud for the Public Funds Recovery Act series from 2020 in the 2025 report, improper_solicitation for Graft Act violation reports, conflict_of_interest), item=, outcome= (substantiated, unsubstantiated, investigation_completed, under_investigation, substantiated_rate, approved, accepted, handled, etc.), measure= (protection type), sector=, type=, agency=, accused_sector=, channel=. Decision needed: public_subsidy_fraud and public_funds_fraud describe the same reporting channel (2020-2024 values identical); merge them or keep the series apart.

program_rules.applies_to: monetary award (포상금) for corruption reports, general case
program_rules.location: p. 64-65 (PDF p. 65-66), "Rewards and award money for whistleblowers"
program_rules.quote: If a reporter satisfies one of the above conditions, the award money of less than KRW 100 million can be paid
program_rules.notes: As described in the 2013 report; validity dates not given.

program_rules.applies_to: monetary award for a person who discloses having received pecuniary benefits (self-disclosure): less than one fifth of the benefits disclosed
program_rules.location: p. 64-65 (PDF p. 65-66), "Rewards and award money for whistleblowers"
program_rules.quote: the amount of award shall be less than a fifth of the pecuniary benefits disclosed but not exceeding KRW 200 million
program_rules.notes: As described in the 2013 report; validity dates not given.

program_rules.applies_to: rewards (보상금) for corruption reports, as described in the 2013 report
program_rules.location: p. 64-65 (PDF p. 65-66), "Rewards and award money for whistleblowers"
program_rules.quote: The maximum amount of reward shall be less than KRW 2 billion, from 4% to 20% of the recovered or increased revenues or the reduced costs
program_rules.notes: Validity dates not stated in this report; the 2015 report says the band became 4-30% for reports after 20 Oct 2015. The 4% minimum and 2 billion cap are already in the rules table from the 2015 report.

program_rules.applies_to: public-interest reports: minimum administrative charge or penalty imposed on the violator for a reward to be payable
program_rules.quote: there will be no reward money for cases where the amount of the imposed administrative charge/penalty on the violator is too small (the minimum penalty was raised from KRW 500,000 to KRW 1 million)
program_rules.notes: Start date not given.

program_rules.applies_to: public-interest reports: minimum administrative charge or penalty imposed on the violator for a reward to be payable
program_rules.quote: The Commission revised the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Protection of Public Interest Whistleblowers on Sep. 2, 2014 ... (the minimum penalty was raised from KRW 500,000 to KRW 1 million)
program_rules.notes: valid_from = date of the decree revision as printed; end date not in this report.

program_rules.applies_to: public-interest rewards
program_rules.quote: it also issued the “public announcement on reward for public interest whistleblowers” on Oct. 31, 2014, which limits the number of reward payment to 10 times a year per person
program_rules.notes: Proposed new rule type (no existing rule fits): maximum number of reward payments per person per year.

program_rules.applies_to: monetary award (포상금) for corruption reports made after 20 Oct 2015
program_rules.quote: for the corruption reports made after October 20, 2015, the maximum reward has increased from the current 2 billion KRW to 3 billion KRW, and the maximum award has increased from the current 100 million KRW to 200 million KRW
program_rules.notes: Previous award cap KRW 100 million (recorded undated from the 2013 report).

program_rules.applies_to: monetary award for a person who discloses having received money or valuables (self-disclosure): up to 30% of the amount reported
program_rules.quote: if the person discloses that he/she received money or other valuables, up to 30% of the amount reported, but not exceeding KRW 500 million, can be provided as an award

events.title: Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act promulgated
events.description: The Act on the Protection of Public Interest Whistleblowers was established and promulgated on 29 March 2011; it took effect on 30 September 2011 with its Enforcement Decree.
events.quote: The Act was established and promulgated on March 29 in 2011

events.title: Corruption Report Center becomes the Corruption and Public Interest Violation Report Center
events.description: The ACRC expanded its Corruption Report Center to also receive public-interest violation reports when the new Act took effect.
events.quote: the Commission has expanded the existing Corruption Report Center to the Corruption and Public Interest Violation Report Center on September 30, 2011

events.title: ACRC creates two public-interest whistleblowing divisions
events.description: The Public Interest Whistleblowing Inspection & Policy Division and the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Division were set up within the ACRC.
events.quote: the Public Interest Whistleblowing Inspection & Policy Division and the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Division were established on October 26, 2011

events.title: Minimum penalty for a public-interest reward raised to KRW 1 million
events.description: Enforcement Decree of the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act revised so that no reward is paid where the penalty imposed is below KRW 1 million (previously KRW 500,000), aimed at "bounty hunter" reporters.
events.quote: The Commission revised the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Protection of Public Interest Whistleblowers on Sep. 2, 2014.

events.title: Public-interest rewards limited to 10 payments a year per person
events.description: ACRC public announcement on rewards for public interest whistleblowers caps the number of reward payments per person.
events.quote: issued the “public announcement on reward for public interest whistleblowers” on Oct. 31, 2014, which limits the number of reward payment to 10 times a year per person

events.title: Government bill to amend the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act submitted
events.description: Bill widening the laws covered, culpability mitigation and enforcement of ACRC protection decisions submitted to the National Assembly; under sub-committee review from 3 Dec 2014.
events.quote: finally submitted the draft for the revision to the National Assembly on Sep. 26, 2013

events.title: Improper Solicitation and Graft Act promulgated
events.description: Passed 3 Mar 2015, promulgated 27 Mar 2015, in force 28 Sep 2016; provides for reports of violations to the ACRC and other bodies, protection of reporters and monetary rewards and awards.
events.quote: •Promulgated (March 27, 2015), and enforced (Sept. 28, 2016)

events.title: Revised Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act promulgated
events.description: Laws covered rise from 180 to 279 (99 added); rewards limited to internal whistleblowers; an awards system introduced; non-compliance charge, right to object, special protection for internal whistleblowers. Passed July 2015; in force 25 Jan 2016.
events.quote: a revision bill was prepared, and was subsequently promulgated on July 24, 2015

events.title: Welfare fraud report centre expanded to Center for Reporting Public Subsidy Fraud
events.description: The Government Welfare Fraud Report Center set up under the ACRC on 15 Oct 2013 was expanded to cover subsidies in all sectors.
events.quote: In January 19, 2015, the center was expanded and reorganized as “Center for Reporting Public Subsidy Fraud” to cover all sectors of subsidies.

events.title: Government Welfare Fraud Report Center established under the ACRC
events.description: Centre for reports of fraudulent welfare claims, later (19 Jan 2015) the Center for Reporting Public Subsidy Fraud.
events.quote: The government established the “Government Welfare Fraud Report Center” under the ACRC on October 15, 2013

events.title: Improper Solicitation and Graft Act takes effect
events.description: The Act, with reporting channels to the ACRC and rewards and awards for reporters of violations, came into force.
events.quote: the ACRC enforced the Improper Solicitation and Graft Act on September 28, 2016

events.title: Confidentiality duty for corruption reporters extended to everyone
events.description: ACRC Act amendment (Act No. 15024, 31 Oct 2017) prohibits anyone, not only Commission and investigative-agency staff, from disclosing or alluding to a reporter's identity; in force 1 Feb 2018.
events.quote: (amended by Act No. 15024 on October 31, 2017 and enforced on February 1, 2018) Article 64 Section 1

events.title: Corruption-reporter protection extended to reports on private-school staff
events.description: ACRC Act revision in April 2017 expanded protection for people who report corruption involving private school faculty members.
events.quote: Since the revision of the ACRC Act in April 2017, protection has been expanded for people who report corruption involving private school faculty members.

events.title: Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act amendment passed (punitive damages)
events.description: Amendment passed the National Assembly in September 2017, to take effect in May 2018: punitive damages up to three times for retaliation, reversed burden of proof, emergency relief, faster relief money; "other equivalent public interests" added; protection period extended from three months to one year.
events.quote: The revision bill of the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act ... passed the National Assembly in September 2017, and will come into effect in May 2018

events.title: Proxy reporting through a lawyer for public-interest reports
events.description: Public-interest reporters can file through an appointed lawyer without giving their own name (substitute reporting).
events.quote: In October 2018, substitute reporting system under which reporters do not have to disclose their real names for reporting was introduced

events.title: 9 December proclaimed Day of Public Interest Whistleblowing
events.description: Proclaimed at the 2018 Anti-Corruption Week event.
events.quote: The ACRC also proclaimed December 9 of every year as the “Day of Public Interest Whistleblowing”

events.title: ACRC Act amendment strengthens corruption-reporter protection
events.description: Protection extended to people who testify in court or the National Assembly or report to investigative agencies; compliance charge, reconciliation recommendation and relief fund introduced for corruption reporters; punishment for forcing withdrawal of reports.
events.quote: The enforcement of the amended ACRC Act on October 17, 2019 greatly reinforced the level of protections for corruption reporters.

events.title: Heavier penalties for disclosing a corruption reporter's identity
events.description: ACRC Act amended 10 Dec 2019 (in force 11 Jun 2020): disclosure of a reporter's identity punishable by up to 5 years or KRW 50 million (was 3 years or KRW 30 million); non-compliance with temporary suspension up to 1 year or KRW 10 million (was 6 months or KRW 5 million).
events.quote: The amendment of the ACRC Act on December 10, 2019, which will take effect on June 11, 2020, substantially strengthened the level of punishment

events.title: Public Funds Recovery Act enacted
events.description: Act on Prohibition of False Claims for Public Funds and Recovery of Illicit Profits enacted, to take effect 1 Jan 2020, with protection and rewards for reporters of false claims.
events.quote: On April 16, 2018, the Act on Prohibition of False Claims for Public Funds and Recovery of Illicit Profits was enacted and was to be implemented on January 1, 2020.

events.title: Lawyer advisory group for proxy reporting, costs paid by government
events.description: Since July 2019 the ACRC runs an advisory group of lawyers; consultation and proxy-reporting costs are funded from the government budget.
events.quote: the ACRC has been running an advisory group consisting of lawyers since July 2019. The cost for consultation and proxy reporting was provided from the government budget

events.title: Laws covered by the public-interest reporting act rise from 284 to 467
events.description: Amendment passed April 2020, proclaimed May 2020 and in force 20 Nov 2020: 182 laws added (incl. child abuse, sexual crimes, Military Service Act), 3 repealed laws deleted, 4 branched laws added.
events.quote: The amended Act on Protection of Public Interest Reporters that passed the National Assembly plenary session was proclaimed in May 2020 and enforced from November 20, 2020.

events.title: ACRC creates an Illicit Profit Recovery Institution Division
events.description: New division to run the Public Funds Recovery Act institutions (five more staff).
events.quote: Illicit Profit Recovery Institution Division has been newly established ... (implemented on Apr. 28, ‘20)

events.title: ACRC Act amendment: wider immunity, emergency relief fund, corruption award cap KRW 500 million
events.description: Amended ACRC Act and decree in force July 2022: liability reduction extended to administrative measures, ACRC may ask courts for immunity, relief funds cover litigation costs and can be paid before deliberation, corruption award cap raised from KRW 200 million to 500 million; non-real-name proxy reporting extended to corruption, Graft Act and Code of Conduct reports (June-July 2022).
events.quote: The amended Act on the Prevention of Corruption and the Establishment and Management of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC Act) and its Enforcement Decree came into effect in July 2022

events.title: Conflict of Interest Prevention Act takes effect
events.description: New law with mandatory reports by officials and violation reports by the public; one of the five anti-corruption laws whose reporter protection and reward rules the ACRC plans to unify.
events.quote: With the enforcement of the Conflict of Interest Prevention Act on May 19, 2022

events.title: Proxy (non-real-name) reporting under the Graft Act
events.description: Graft Act amendment promulgated 7 Dec 2021 and in force 8 Jun 2022 lets reporters of improper solicitation file through a lawyer without giving their identity.
events.quote: the Anti-Graft Act was amended to introduce a “non-real name proxy report system,” ... (promulgated on December 7, 2021, and enforced on June 8, 2022)

events.title: Public-interest rewards extended to recoveries by public corporations
events.description: Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act amended so rewards can be paid when public institutions such as public corporations, not only national and local governments, recover revenue.
events.quote: the 「Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act」 was revised in March to allow monetary rewards to be paid even if the revenue of not only public institutions such as national and local governments as well as public corporations / organizations for public interest, is recovered or increased

events.title: Public Funds Recovery Division takes over subsidy-fraud reports
events.description: The Public Funds Recovery System Division and the Center for Reporting Welfare and Subsidy Fraud merged into a new Public Funds Recovery Division.
events.quote: on May 1, 2023 ... the 「Public Funds Recovery Division」, which is an integration of the existing 'Public Funds Recovery System Division' and the 'Center for Reporting Welfare and Subsidy Fraud', has been newly launched

events.title: Public Funds Recovery Act amendment in force: proxy reporting and relief fund for reporters
events.description: Amendment of 26 Mar 2024 (in force 27 Sep 2024): non-real-name proxy reporting and a relief fund for reporters of false claims, criminal penalties for false claims, interest and sanction-reduction changes.
events.quote: In 2024, the Public Fund Recovery Act was amended on March 26 ... (6) introduction of non-real name proxy reporting; (7) establishment of a relief fund system. The revised law has been in effect since September 27, 2024.

events.title: Public-interest act amended: legal-aid costs for internal whistleblowers, 22 laws added
events.description: 2024 amendments to the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act: legal assistance costs for internal whistleblowers, duty for all receiving agencies to inform reporters of protection, cap on rewards abolished, subrogation access to property information, 22 laws added (495 laws as of 20 Mar 2025).
events.quote: The major amendments to the Act on the Protection of Public Interest Whistleblowers in 2024 include, first, the establishment of a legal basis for supporting legal assistance costs for internal whistleblowers.

events.title: Public-interest rewards for recoveries by public institutions take effect
events.description: For public-interest reports filed on or after 22 Sep 2023, rewards can be paid for recoveries or revenue increases of public institutions, not only central and local government.
events.quote: for reports filed on or after September 22, 2023, a whistleblower may apply for a reward not only for the direct recovery or increase of revenue for the central government or a local government, but also for that of a public institution

events.title: ACRC Act: protection and rewards for reports of corruption at private schools
events.description: Revision in force April 2017 extends reporter protection and rewards to reports of corruption in private schools.
events.quote: 지난 4 월 부패방지권익위법 개정 · 시행으로 사립학교의 부패행위를 신고하는 경우에도 보호 · 보상을 받을 수 있게 됨에 따라

events.title: "Equivalent public interest" added to the public-interest reporting areas
events.description: A sixth area, "other comparable public interest", added to the five areas covered by the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection Act.
events.quote: 2018년 5월에 신규 추가된 ‘이에 준하는 공공의 이익‘ 분야

new_indicators.name: Average reward per paid claim
new_indicators.definition: Average reward paid per approved application or rewarded case over a period, as printed by the source.

new_indicators.definition: Rewards paid as a share of the money recovered (reward-eligible amount) over a period, as printed by the source.

ledger.contains: English annual report of the ACRC for 2010 (104 pages). Programme content: corruption reports received by year 2002-2010 (total, corruption allegations, Code of Conduct violations, general grievances); reports handled by outcome; reports transferred to investigative agencies by year with investigation results and substantiation rates, by receiving agency and (for 2010) by sector and type; people indicted/reprimanded and money levied; insider whistle-blowing referrals; protection requests by year and type with outcomes; fines for identity-protection breaches; honours and award money for informants; reward applications, approvals, recovered amounts and reward money by year 2002-2010; and the legislative history of the Public Interest Whistleblower Protection bill (2008-2010). Rest of the report (ombudsman complaints, integrity assessments, corruption impact assessment, officials dismissed for corruption, subsidy inspections, Code of Conduct operation, education, administrative appeals) is out of scope. Reward-table total for recovered amount is misprinted ("21,954,733,31") and 2010 is printed "45,05,568,093" (already recorded as 4505568093); text gives "almost 22 billion won" (recorded). Bill milestones (submitted to National Assembly 29 Oct 2009, etc.) not recorded as events because the Act itself (2011) is already an event.

English annual report of the ACRC for 2011 (104 pages).
